title: Morningstar: Japan ETF Market Q1 2026 Flow Analysis
tags: Morningstar’s Analysis of the NISA MarketThe year 2025, the second following Japan’s landmark NISA reforms, saw a massive and steady flow of capital into the market, with total net inflows reaching approximately ¥14.2 trillion. However, this headline figure masks the year’s defining characteristic: a profound qualitative shift in how that capital is being allocated.Japan FinTech ObserverNorbert Gehrke
